note: Phrase rules that map a publisher's own description of a behaviour to one DISARM v1.6.1 technique. A rule fires on a sentence the publisher wrote (after scrub); the matched phrase is kept with the id. A behaviour no rule matches stays as text and is not forced into an id. A technique from a rule has basis 'mapped': it is Undertow's reading of the publisher's words, not the publisher's claim. Ids and names checked against DISARM v1.6.1's STIX bundle (generated_files/DISARM_STIX/DISARM.json at tag v1.6.1) on 14 Nov 2026.

review.note: Drafted 14 Nov 2026 from the candidate rules in _ideas/drafts/2026-11-14-influence-ops-step12.md section 2, plus six more. Reviewed by Tom on the evening of 14 Nov 2026 CST (15 Nov UTC) from the table in _ideas/drafts/2026-11-14-undertow-disarm-review.md, which shows each rule's pattern and the sentences it matched in the 14 Nov collect: 15 rules approved as written; dr-04 lost its bare 'AI-generated content' alternative (it read an unnamed medium as images) and dr-10 lost 'standalone websites' (not every standalone website is a news site). Confirmed by Tom on 19 Nov 2026: all 17 rules accepted, dr-09 kept with no matches yet; each rule carries review 'accepted' and the date.
